markets.rules_primary: If Donald Trump has taken any presidential actions on Nov 25, 2026 (as checked on the “Presidential Actions” page at whitehouse.gov at 10:00 AM ET on Nov 26, 2026), then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
How this is resolved

The market solely resolves to the publication date visibly displayed on the "Presidential Actions" tab at whitehouse.gov at 10:00 AM ET the following day.

Payout criteria

The actions may include proclamations, executive orders, nominations & appointments, and memoranda.
Any item listed on the page counts, regardless of its legal effect.

Examples (for Jan 10, 2026):

Executive Order with a Jan 7 signing date is released with a Jan 10 publication date → resolves Yes
Proclamation e-mailed to White House Press Pool but not uploaded by 10:00 AM next day → resolves No
Proclamation is released Jan 10 with a backdated Jan 9 publication date → resolves No
Bill signed into law and shows up on "Briefings & Statements" instead of "Presidential Actions" → resolves No

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if Bitcoin crosses the specified price threshold.
markets.rules_primary: If the Bitcoin spot price according to the CF Bitcoin Real-Time Index is above $130000 starting Sep 22, 2026 and before Nov 26, 2026 at 10:00 AM ET, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary: The market resolves based on the CF Bitcoin Real-Time Index (BRTI) using a trimmed mean calculation. The resolution value is calculated by taking all BRTI values for each minute from market issuance until the specified time on the target date, removing the top 20% and bottom 20% of values, then averaging the remaining 60% of values. If the BRTI crosses the threshold at any point during the measurement period (triggering early expiration), the market immediately resolves. If no data is available at the expiration time, the market resolves to No. The market can resolve early if Bitcoin definitively crosses the threshold before the target date and time.

How this is resolved

A day counts once Getty Images' Editorial search, filtered to the "Donald Trump - US President" people tag with the Custom date range From and To both set to that day and no other filters, shows at least one photo, regardless of the time zone where the photo was taken.
If no such photo is shown by 10:00 AM ET the next day, the market resolves No.
